measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: the two small mounting holes near the centre: hole diameter, centre-to-centre distance, and the angle of the line between them relative to the direction the input wires leave (e.g. 'perpendicular to the wires', 'along the wires'), and whether they're symmetric about the disc centre

measures.what: board thickness, and the height of the tallest thing on the back face (connector/components), plus how far from the disc centre the connector/wires are on the back
measures.reply: led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: length and width of the board, board thickness, and centre-to-centre spacing of its four corner holes (along long side and short side), plus hole diameter

measures.what: height of the tallest thing above the top face (ESP32 on its headers, capacitor), and how far solder joints/leads stick out below the bottom face

measures.what: which perfboard edge the port faces (short or long edge), how far the port mouth is from that board edge (+ overhang, - inset), the port centre's offset sideways from the middle of that edge, and the port centre's height above the perfboard top face

measures.what: width and thickness of the plastic overmold (the grip part behind the metal plug), and the length of the metal tip
measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.

measures.what: Could you measure across the disc with a ruler (edge to edge through the centre), even roughly? And what's on the back face: is the 4-pin connector on the back, how tall does it stand, and roughly how far from the centre is it (towards 12 o'clock)?
measures.reply: led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: how far solder joints and component leads stick out below the bottom face (roughly), and the height of the screw terminals and capacitor above the top face
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard grid: 18 x 24 holes at 2.54 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: Two numbers please: (1) Lay a ruler across the perfboard's short edge nearest the USB-C port. Is the port's mouth sticking out past that edge or sitting back inside it, and by how many mm? (2) Measure from the perfboard's left long edge (port pointing at you) to the middle of the USB-C port's mouth.
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.item: the four wires between perfboard and disc
measures.what: how long they are (perfboard end to disc end), and where on the disc they attach: how far in from the disc's edge at 12 o'clock
measures.reply: led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm
